knowledge:
- key_parameters: logFC=Logarithmic fold-changes of gene expression (treatment vs control) from miRNA overexpression experiments ;; seqScores=Matrix of sequence-based scores (e.g., TargetScan context+ score, PCT) where columns represent different features ;; tol=Tolerance threshold for VB-EM convergence (e.g., 1e-3) ;; maxiter=Maximum number of iterations for the VB-EM algorithm (e.g., 200)
- alternatives: GenMiR++ and GroupMiR (correlation-based methods requiring large sets of expression profiles across various tissues/conditions, whereas TargetScore is condition-specific and unsupervised) ;; Regression-based methods (require training data, unlike TargetScore which is unsupervised)
- when_to_use: When you have microRNA transfection/overexpression expression data (microarray or RNA-seq) and want to identify direct, condition-specific miRNA targets by combining expression changes with sequence-based target predictions (like TargetScan scores).
- pitfalls: Off-target effects can cause positive fold-changes or unexpected up-regulation, which TargetScore models using a 3-component VB-GMM for logFC, but users should be aware of this biological noise ;; Using pre-filtered gene sets above arbitrary cutoffs can bias the overall likelihood; TargetScore should ideally be operated on the entire gene set.

workflows.name: target_score_direct_analysis
workflows.intent: Calculate target scores directly from user-provided log fold-changes and sequence-based scores.
input: logFC vector (log2 fold-changes from transfection vs control)
seqScores matrix (sequence-based scores like TargetScan context scores or PCT).
workflows.stages: 1. Load TargetScore library ;; 2. Prepare logFC and sequence scores matrix ;; 3. Run targetScore function to compute posterior probabilities.
workflows.code:
library(TargetScore)
trmt <- c(rnorm(10,mean=0.01), rnorm(1000,mean=1), rnorm(90,mean=2)) + 1e3
ctrl <- c(rnorm(1100,mean=1)) + 1e3
logFC <- log2(trmt) - log2(ctrl)
seqScoreA <- c(rnorm(8,mean=-2), rnorm(1092,mean=0))
seqScoreB <- c(rnorm(20,mean=-2), rnorm(1080,mean=0))
seqScores <- cbind(seqScoreA, seqScoreB)             
p.targetScore <- targetScore(logFC, seqScores, tol=1e-3)
pairs(cbind(p.targetScore, logFC, seqScoreA, seqScoreB))

workflows.name: target_score_via_targetscoredata
workflows.intent: Retrieve precomputed sequence scores and validated targets for a specific miRNA and compute target scores.
input: logFC.imputed matrix (optional, precomputed or user-supplied logFC).
workflows.stages: 1. Load TargetScoreData and gplots libraries ;; 2. Run getTargetScores with miRNA ID ;; 3. (Optional) Retrieve precomputed logFC matrix for multiple miRNAs.
workflows.code:
library(TargetScoreData)
library(gplots)
myTargetScores <- getTargetScores("hsa-miR-1", tol=1e-3, maxiter=200)
table((myTargetScores$targetScore > 0.1), myTargetScores$validated)
logFC.imputed <- get_precomputed_logFC()
mirIDs <- unique(colnames(logFC.imputed))

workflows.name: target_score_limma_pipeline
workflows.intent: Perform differential expression analysis on microarray data using limma, then compute target scores using getTargetScores.
workflows.stages: 1. Download and normalize microarray data ;; 2. Define design matrix and fit linear model using limma ;; 3. Compute contrast and run eBayes ;; 4. Extract logFC and map to gene symbols ;; 5. Run getTargetScores using the computed logFC.
workflows.code:
library(limma)
library(Biobase)
library(GEOquery)
library(gplots)
gset <- getGEO("GSE11701", GSEMatrix =TRUE, AnnotGPL=TRUE)
if (length(gset) > 1) idx <- grep("GPL6104", attr(gset, "names")) else idx <- 1
gset <- gset[[idx]]
geneInfo <- fData(gset)
x <- normalizeVSN(exprs(gset))
pData(gset)$title
design <- model.matrix(~0+factor(c(1,1,1,1,2,2,2,2)))
colnames(design) <- c("preNeg_control", "miR_205_transfect")
fit <- lmFit(x, design)
contrast.matrix <- makeContrasts(miR_205_transfect-preNeg_control,levels=design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
limma_stats <- topTable(fit2, coef=1, number=nrow(fit2))
limma_stats$gene_symbol <- geneInfo[match(limma_stats$ID, geneInfo$ID), "Gene symbol"]
logFC <- as.matrix(limma_stats$logFC)
rownames(logFC) <- limma_stats$gene_symbol
myTargetScores <- getTargetScores("hsa-miR-205", logFC, tol=1e-3, maxiter=200)

workflows.name: target_score_deseq_pipeline
workflows.intent: Perform differential expression analysis on RNA-seq count data using DESeq, then compute target scores using targetScore.
input: CountDataSet (RNA-seq raw counts for treatment and control)
workflows.stages: 1. Estimate size factors and dispersions using DESeq ;; 2. Perform negative binomial test to get log2 fold changes ;; 3. Extract logFC and combine with sequence scores ;; 4. Run targetScore.
workflows.code:
library(DESeq)
cds <- makeExampleCountDataSet()
cds <- estimateSizeFactors( cds )
cds <- estimateDispersions( cds )
deseq_stats <- nbinomTest( cds, "A", "B" )
logFC <- deseq_stats$log2FoldChange[1:100]
seqScoreA <- rnorm(length(logFC))
seqScoreB <- rnorm(length(logFC))
seqScores <- cbind(seqScoreA, seqScoreB)
p.targetScore <- targetScore(logFC, seqScores, tol=1e-3)
